newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma stretches down, hugs 311 in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma stretches down, hugs 311 in late trade.

text.p: The drachma garnered strength against the ecu steading just above 311 in late dealings after the central bank sold more than $100 million for drachmas at the fixing, dealers said.

"Ecu/drachma dipped just below 311 after the fixing but has firmed a bit trading currently just above 311 as some banks sought to close out short ecu, long drachma positions," a forex dealer at a foreign bank said.
Ecu/drachma which was hovering around 311.60/70 before Friday's fixing is currently trading at 311.00/10.
The central bank sold more than $100 million but less than 30 million ecus at today's fixing, dealers said.
"Bank of Greece wanted to punish some players who had speculated against the drachma knowing that a large amount of dollars would be bought at the fixing," said a forex dealer.
Mark/dracha was also softer at 159.20/30 from 159.65/75 before the fixing, traders said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
